title: The Minecraft Missile Everyone Thought was IMPOSSIBLE
description:
It's finally here, the new best precision TNT missile in Minecraft! This missile, known as the Helldiver mk4 Precision Missile, iterates upon designs by Ilmango and Cubehamster. Tired of your friend's base existing, but don't want to spend hundreds of hours building a massive orbital strike device? This is the one for you. Enjoy.
